integrity.proof: analytic piecewise support-function and change-of-variables argument

scientific_limitations: Inverse uniqueness is proved only in the ordered three-peak open region; the forward density holds for all strictly convex kites.
An exact projection-width population law is assumed. No finite-sample singularity estimator or noise bound is established.
Absolute historical priority against unindexed results is not certified.
title: Three spectral singularities reconstruct asymmetric kites from random widths
